stories.headline: Nigeria’s Tinubu pledges to bring peace to rebellion-hit border region
stories.description: Tinubu is under pressure to convince voters that military operations in the country’s northeast will deliver security.

stories.headline: Iraq’s top court rules government can take over Kurdish borders, oil fields
stories.description: The ruling comes a day after Kurdish authorities accused Baghdad of an ‘assault’ on the region’s constitutional rights.

stories.headline: Switzerland forced to close office in North Korea over sanctions feud
stories.description: The closure came after North Korea condemned Switzerland for adding a children’s camp to its sanctions list.

stories.headline: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
stories.description: The discount chain has collapsed into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer.

stories.headline: South Africa court repeals ‘farmgate’ impeachment threat against Ramaphosa
stories.description: The ruling hands the president a political reprieve by removing a finding that had exposed him to possible impeachment.
